items.headline: Scott's TD run helps NC State shake off blown lead, Vanderbilt loss by beating Appalachian State
items.description: — Duke Scott bounced outside to the left for the go-ahead 16-yard touchdown run with 5:08 left that helped N.C. State overcome a blown 21-point lead and beat Appalachian State 41-31 on Saturday night.

items.headline: Malachi Singleton throws for 331 yards and Appalachian State defeats Charlotte 26-21
items.description: — Malachi Singleton threw for 331 yards, Appalachian State built a 19-point, fourth-quarter lead and the Mountaineers outlasted Charlotte 26-21 on Saturday night.
